title: Comparison of Different Tourniquet Release Times in Bunion Surgery
brief_summary: Patients listed for hallux valgus/hallux rigidus correction surgery will be randomised to one of two treatment groups. Group 1 (standard care) will have the calf tourniquet released after wound closure. Group 2 will have the tourniquet removed five minutes before wound closure. Participants will have the volume of their operated foot measured pre-operatively and post-operatively at six weeks and three months.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients having hallux valgus or hallux rigidus
* Able to give informed consent
* Able to return for follow-up

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with symptomatic peripheral vascular disease
* Patients with known peripheral oedema from any cause
* Patients who will also require lesser toe correction as part of the procedure
* Active smokers
